# ikria

> A Keleusma technology demonstrator that flies Kerbal Space Program craft through kRPC, with an MCP server for agents.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the repository from outside, such as a model asked to write code against it.
Links are absolute, so the file works when fetched on its own. They name `HEAD`,
which GitHub resolves to the default branch, whatever it is called.

## Start Here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/ikria/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): onboarding for any AI assistant.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/ikria/blob/HEAD/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.
- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/ikria/blob/HEAD/README.md): project overview and quick start.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/sgeos/ikria/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md): architecture, decisions, roadmap and process.
